name: Ryoujoku Jiken File -File. 1 Renzoku Fujo Shissou Jiken-
original_name: 陵辱事件ファイル－File.1 連続婦女失踪事件－
source:
There is a series of women disappearances in Tokyo. Investigator Yurina Tachibana is appointed to investigate repeating molester cases on the train that seems to be connected to kidnappings. TV newscaster Miho Shinohara also works on a molester train in pursuit of a scoop. The two girls occasionally meet together and start to unwind this case reaching the very bottom of sex cultist scandal.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
东京发生了一连串女性失踪案。调查员橘由里奈受命调查火车上的连续痴汉案，她认为案件似乎与绑架有关。电视新闻主播篠原美穗也在火车上调查痴汉，以追寻独家新闻。两名女孩偶尔相遇，共同抽丝剥茧，最终深入性邪教丑闻的核心。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-october-2004-akai-ito.html]vndbreview[/url]）
